AI Search Expected to Hit 53% of Enterprise Traffic in 2026

New research from 300 enterprise marketing execs reveals a surprising finding: AI search isn't replacing traditional SEO—it's additive. AI search now accounts for 35% of website traffic, and executives predict traditional SEO will also grow to 53% share. The insight: consumers bounce ideas in chatbots, then run follow-up searches with more refined queries. Both channels are growing.

Enterprise Marketing 2026: What's Working vs. Wasting Budget

Essential field guide for enterprise tech marketers. The winners: buying-group ABM, proof-rich thought leadership, visibility in AI answers, customer evidence as media. The losers: spray-and-pray outbound, MQL worship, feature-first messaging, generic AI claims, and "the demo as the main event." The reality: two-thirds of the buying journey happens before sales ever joins the conversation.

AI Agents Now Solving 20 Enterprise Problems—Here's the ROI Playbook

Deloitte says 80% of automation leaders are accelerating AI agent investments. The highest-ROI use cases: customer support automation, invoice processing, recruitment workflows, IT helpdesk, and contract review. Key stat: deployments with audit trails and human-in-the-loop controls reduce compliance incidents by 73%. Start with invoice processing or IT helpdesk—measurable ROI within 8-12 weeks.

B2B Sales Goes AI-First: 65% Now Data-Driven

New B2B trends report shows AI-powered sales agents are now recommending deal strategies and simulating buyer objections. 65% of B2B sales organizations have moved to data-driven strategies. The shift: from human intuition to AI-augmented intelligence across the entire sales cycle—from lead scoring to objection handling to close.
